title: S3.7c torus surface projection across ring, horn, and spindle profiles

scope.geometry: Closest point on the untrimmed torus locus
scope.domain: Finite decoded torus face with majorRadius > 0, minorRadius > 0, and finite nonzero axis; supports ring, horn, and spindle profiles
scope.projection_policy: Project to the full minor-radius circle in the axial/radial cross-section, then lift by the query's radial direction around the torus axis; negative projected radial coordinates are represented by reversing that direction
scope.ambiguity_policy: Refuse points with multiple closest locus points, including most axis points and the major circle; the horn pinch at the axis is accepted when it is the unique closest locus point
scope.frame_policy: The full analytic torus locus is independent of its U reference direction; no parameter value or trim boundary is produced
scope.numeric_policy: Normalize coordinates and radii, retain direction separately from magnitude, and refuse nonrepresentable final coordinates atomically
scope.reference_scope: Official OCCT torus parameterization corroborates the standard major/minor-radius circular-tube locus only; it does not establish ACIS wire semantics, trims, orientation, or validity
non_claims: signed inside/outside classification for horn or spindle torus profiles
torus UV parameterization or trim evaluation
native consumer or independent-kernel semantic qualification

source.reference_reviewed: Official OCCT reference manual documents the torus circular-tube parametrization in normalized local X/Y/Z directions; this was used only as a standard mathematical cross-check.
